removed_items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled corollary at source lines 535-541: under the assumptions of the general spectral gap theorem, the operator norm of the product of the coordinate matrices is at most one minus delta over eight times n plus one. The proof (source lines 542-548) is short, but it does two things the statement hides: it has to check that the parameter choice of the systematic scan, namely k_j equal to j for every coordinate, satisfies the hypotheses of the general theorem, and then it instantiates that theorem, which is where the explicit rate with the denominator eight times n plus one comes from. The statement records only the contraction bound.
